chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Dāwūd ibn al-Ḥuṣayn, from Abī al-ʿAbbās, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about one upon whom the prescribed punishment was carried out and he died: is retaliation to be taken from him, or is his blood-money to be paid? He said: “No, unless there was an excess beyond the retaliation.”
ai.seo_question: If someone dies after a ḥadd or retaliatory punishment is carried out, is qiṣāṣ or diyah required?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a person who dies after a prescribed punishment or retaliatory penalty is carried out upon him. The Imam عليه السلام states that no further retaliation or blood-money is due, except in a case where more than the warranted retaliation was inflicted.
